h1: Connect Drupal to your CRM, search and sign-in tools
overview: We connect your Drupal site to the tools your team already uses, so data moves without copy and paste. Typical jobs include sending form entries to a CRM such as HubSpot, adding a faster search with Solr or Algolia, letting people sign in with your company account through SSO, or taking payments through a gateway. We build it on a staging copy and test it with real sample data before launch.

faq: HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Algolia, Apache Solr, Stripe, OAuth and SAML sign-in are common. Tell us what you use and we confirm the route before you order.
Do I pay for the outside tools?
Yes. Any plan or license for the CRM, search or payment service is paid to its maker. Our price covers the work to connect it.
Can you set up SSO with our company login?
Yes, with providers that support SAML or OAuth, such as Microsoft Entra or Google Workspace. You need to give us a test application in your identity provider.
We use encrypted connections and keep keys out of the code, in your site's settings. We only send the fields we agreed with you, which keeps data use light.
